title: Archive browser
idea: Archive browser: Folder tree and manifest reveal archive contents before extraction
audience: People who need to inspect archive within a desktop surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic collection layout through its inspect archive priority and explicit commitment contract: Extraction validates destination boundaries and collisions
navigation: Archive browser keeps the current inspect archive context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Folder tree and manifest reveal archive contents before extraction
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to inspect archive; users assess packaged files safely
composition.priority: Extraction validates destination boundaries and collisions

imagery.role: Support the actual inspect archive context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Provide accessible breadcrumb list alongside the tree
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the archive browser structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no inspect archive content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Extraction validates destination boundaries and collisions
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized inspect archive content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Extraction validates destination boundaries and collisions
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active inspect archive context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
